## 1. Professional Profile
Olumide Oyediran (founder of Skryptvolt, also known as Mide, SkryptByMide, and Justmide) is an accomplished Nigerian software developer, full-stack engineer, and web systems architect based in Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria.

With extensive expertise in building high-speed, modern web applications, Olumide helps businesses, startups, and international SMEs transform their digital operations. His software architecture philosophy centers around three core pillars:
1. Sub-2.0s real-world loading speed, even on constrained 3G/4G mobile networks.
2. High-converting user experience with friction-free WhatsApp lead funnels.
3. Clean, maintainable software craftsmanship with production-grade SEO, structured schema, and robust security.

## 2. Technical Stack & Capabilities

### Frontend Engineering
- **Languages & Frameworks**: React 18, Next.js, JavaScript (Modern ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5 (Semantic), CSS3.
- **Styling & UI**: Tailwind CSS, PostCSS, Framer Motion (fluid 60fps micro-interactions), Lucide Icons, React Icons.
- **Build Tools & Performance**: Vite, Rollup, Webpack, responsive image optimization, code-splitting, lazy-loading, browser cache headers.

### Backend Engineering & Databases
- **Runtime & Languages**: Node.js, Express.js, Python.
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Firebase Firestore, Supabase.
- **APIs & Protocols**: RESTful APIs, WebSockets, Webhooks, JSON-LD Schema.org, Third-Party SDK Integrations.

### Server Deployment & Cloud Infrastructure
- **Hosting Environments**: cPanel Web Hosting, DirectAdmin, Ubuntu VPS, Vercel, Netlify, Render.
- **Domain & DNS Management**: Cloudflare CDN, Nameservers, A Records, CNAME, TXT, MX records.
- **Email Systems**: Professional custom business email setup (Google Workspace, Zoho Mail, cPanel Webmail) with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC verification to prevent spam filtering.
- **Security**: Free & Custom SSL/TLS certificates, HTTPS enforcement, CSRF & XSS protection, CSP headers.

### Payment Gateways & FinTech Integrations
- **Paystack**: Automated card payments, bank transfers, USSD, recurring billing.
- **Flutterwave**: Multi-currency checkout (NGN, USD, GBP, EUR, KES, GHS).
- **Stripe**: International card payments and subscription billing.

## 4. Notable Projects & Case Studies

### 1. SkyBridge Pathways Global
- **Domain**: International Education, Study Abroad & Visa Advisory
- **Stack**: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Node.js API
- **Outcome**: 300% increase in qualified consultation bookings; mobile load time cut to 1.4 seconds.

### 2. ApexCare Clinical Portal
- **Domain**: Healthcare & Private Medical Practice
- **Stack**: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, WhatsApp Booking Engine
- **Outcome**: Streamlined patient intake, eliminated double-bookings, ranked #1 locally on Google Maps for local queries.

### 3. PrimeLogistics Freight Hub
- **Domain**: Logistics, Freight & Domestic Courier
- **Stack**: React, REST APIs, WhatsApp Dispatch Trigger
- **Outcome**: Enabled real-time rate quotes directly on mobile, reducing phone support load by 60%.

### 4. UrbanStyle Boutique
- **Domain**: E-Commerce, Fashion & Luxury Apparel
- **Stack**: React, Paystack API, Flutterwave API, Cloudinary
- **Outcome**: Combined card checkout with WhatsApp ordering, boosting Nigerian conversion rates by 45%.
